# Language

**Which language do we speak and write in?** · [all approaches](index.md)


## English speech and text
<a id="english"></a>

Everything in English.

**Looks like:** English voice, English captions and caption copy. It reads cleanly to a global or pan-India audience.

**Good at:** global reach; matches most reference creators; easier copy tests

**Weak at:** less local warmth; competes with global creators

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, reel90, yt-short, yt-long, carousel · niches all · goals reach · effort low

**How:** Auto-captions in Edits/CapCut, or faster-whisper word timings for custom captions.

**Backed by:** [Hinglish voice and captions](../topics/text.md#text-hinglish-voice), [Word-by-word captions, key word highlighted](../topics/text.md#text-word-by-word-highlight), [Word-level transcription for captions and cuts](../topics/ai-tools.md#ai-word-level-transcription), [Caption: hook line, story, CTA, 3–5 tags](../topics/text.md#text-caption-structure) · sources SP

## Hinglish speech, English captions
<a id="hinglish-speech-english-text"></a>

Talk naturally in Hindi/Hinglish while labels and captions stay in English (Rahul's pattern).

**Looks like:** 'Achchha, October mein ek lakh ka PC?' spoken, with 'DON'T BUY' and '₹1,00,000' in English on screen. It feels local and still scans fast.

**Good at:** Indian relatability; personality; Indian tech audience fit

**Weak at:** non-Hindi viewers depend on captions; translation work for captions

**Best for:** formats reel60, reel90, yt-short · niches tech, gaming, gym · goals trust, comments, follows · effort medium

**How:** Whisper language 'hi' for timing, then write English labels by hand in CapCut.

**Backed by:** [Hinglish voice and captions](../topics/text.md#text-hinglish-voice), [Caption: hook line, story, CTA, 3–5 tags](../topics/text.md#text-caption-structure), [No intro: topic and number first](../topics/hooks.md#hook-no-intro-payoff-first), [Long candid caption as a personal note](../topics/text.md#text-long-candid-caption) · sources R1

## Hinglish throughout
<a id="hinglish-throughout"></a>

Hinglish voice and Hinglish (Roman script) captions.

**Looks like:** Captions read 'Aapko pata hai Gmail mein sirf ek word badlo...' word by word. It sounds like a friend talking.

**Good at:** warmth; Indian shares; stands out in English-heavy feeds

**Weak at:** narrower outside India; Roman Hindi spelling varies

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, story · niches all · goals shares, comments · effort low

**How:** Write the captions by hand; auto-captions mangle Hinglish.

**Backed by:** [Hinglish voice and captions](../topics/text.md#text-hinglish-voice), [Caption: hook line, story, CTA, 3–5 tags](../topics/text.md#text-caption-structure), [Word-by-word captions, key word highlighted](../topics/text.md#text-word-by-word-highlight), [Word-level transcription for captions and cuts](../topics/ai-tools.md#ai-word-level-transcription) · sources R1, KH

## Switch by theme
<a id="switch-by-theme"></a>

Choose per post: chill or local posts in Hinglish, teaching or global posts in English.

**Looks like:** A travel vibe reel with a Hinglish caption ('chill scenes'), next to an English tech explainer. The language matches the mood.

**Good at:** fits each post; tests both audiences; matches mood

**Weak at:** less consistent voice; two caption voices to maintain

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, carousel, story · niches all · goals reach, shares · effort low

**How:** Decide the language in the copy pack, before writing.

**Backed by:** [Hinglish voice and captions](../topics/text.md#text-hinglish-voice), [Caption: hook line, story, CTA, 3–5 tags](../topics/text.md#text-caption-structure), [Travel formats: vibe, dump, POV, "nobody tells you"](../topics/ideas.md#ideas-travel-formats), [Contrast hook: looks X, sounds Y](../topics/hooks.md#hook-contrast-looks-sounds) · sources SP, KH

## Mixing
Hinglish speech with English labels is itself a mix. Captions can switch even when the voice doesn't.

## Rule of thumb
Global reach: English. Indian tech and personality: Hinglish speech with English text. Local warmth: Hinglish throughout.
